summary: Proved the protected fixed-path gap test, documented conditional packing and scale transfer, and established a lower bound for fault-oblivious path lists. Exact checks passed. The full construction remains unresolved; a weaker shortest-violation separator is sufficient and still unproved.
next_test: Construct or diagnose an H-dependent shortest-violation separator with O(r*f) protected fault witnesses and time 2^O(r+d*log(d+2))*poly(n,f,r), complete whenever an original-budget fault set gives G-F distance exactly d and H-F distance greater than r.
